capability.summary: Explicit user request to fix the two reproduced freeze blockers overrides the default GA-only scope. Keep generation harmony changes within selected steps and retain MIDI bindings across ordinary edits, while safely stopping voices. No new product features.

controls.description: Generated voicings bypass automatic harmony only on their own steps; other steps and track settings retain their sound.
controls.test: Untouched phrase PCM equality, protected/partial selections, preview/apply, all render paths, clipboard/repeats/sections, persistence/history and version-safe imports.

controls.description: Ordinary edits and undo stop MIDI voices but preserve device bindings; load/unplug still disconnect.
controls.test: Held and releasing voices, repeated edits and late ended callbacks, GUI key change, future input, undo/redo, load and unplug.
